title: A multiplier bootstrap score test for Tobit specification
abstract: arXiv:2610.28169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple score-based specification test for the Tobit regression model, implemented through a computationally efficient multiplier bootstrap. We test correct specification through the conditional moment restriction that the generalized Tobit residual has zero conditional mean, and construct a feasible score-based empirical process using the integrated conditional moments approach, conditioning on the estimated index so that no smoothing or tuning parameter is required. We derive a first-order uniform representation of the feasible process, showing how its limiting behavior is affected by maximum-likelihood estimation of the structural parameter, and obtain the asymptotic properties of the corresponding Kolmogorov--Smirnov statistic under the null, fixed alternatives, and a sequence of local alternatives. translated_title: 一种针对Tobit模型设定的乘数自助计分检验
translated_abstract: 本文针对Tobit回归模型提出了一种简单的基于计分的设定检验方法，并通过计算高效的乘数自助法加以实现。我们通过“广义Tobit残差的条件均值为零”这一条件矩约束来检验模型设定的正确性，并采用积分条件矩方法构建了可行的基于计分的经验过程，以估计的指标变量为条件，因而无需任何平滑或调节参数。我们推导了该可行过程的一阶一致表示，揭示了其极限行为如何受结构参数极大似然估计的影响，并在原假设、固定备择假设以及局部备择假设序列下得到了相应Kolmogorov–Smirnov统计量的渐近性质。由于极限原假设分布是非枢轴的，p值通过乘数自助法获得……
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Tobit回归模型的计分设定检验方法，利用乘数自助法计算p值，无需平滑或调节参数且计算高效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a score-based specification test for the Tobit regression model with a computationally efficient multiplier bootstrap that requires no smoothing or tuning parameters.
